name: Cobra Mission: Panic in Cobra City
source:
BOND WAS HOT STUFF.
SO WAS ARNIE.
NOW IT'S YOUR TURN.

You stumbled back to your office after a long day of detective work. But before you can get cozy with a whiskey bottle, there's a message waiting on the phone machine.

"This is a life and death emergency!! Young ladies have been disappearing left and right, and now, Donna is missing!! We need your help!! Please come quickly!!!"

Donna's rescue is only the beginning of this sizzling adventure. There's dozens more tantalizing women held against their will. Free them from the evil clutches of General Kaiser, Cobra's psychotic master criminal overlord, and they will thank you in ways that will leave you screaming in ecstasy.

[From [url=https://archive.org/details/adult-pc-guide-february-1996/Adult%20PC%20Guide%20February%201996/page/n75/mode/1up]print advertisement[/url]]
translation:
邦德曾经风光无限。
阿诺德也是。
现在轮到你了。

在漫长的一天侦探工作后，你踉跄着回到办公室。但在你还没来得及与威士忌酒瓶亲近之前，电话答录机上已经有一条留言在等着你了。

"这是生死攸关的紧急情况！！年轻女性接连失踪，现在连唐娜也不见了！！我们需要你的帮助！！请速来！！！"

营救唐娜只是这场火热冒险的开始。还有数十位令人垂涎的女性被非法囚禁。将她们从眼镜蛇城的疯狂犯罪霸主——凯撒将军的邪恶魔爪中解救出来，她们会以让你在极乐中尖叫的方式来报答你。

[来自[url=https://archive.org/details/adult-pc-guide-february-1996/Adult%20PC%20Guide%20February%201996/page/n75/mode/1up]印刷广告[/url]]
